data.name: PlanetWithId
data.comment: A planet whose name is not known yet (no SDE). {0} is its id number.

data.name: TypeWithId
data.comment: An item type whose name is not known yet (no SDE). {0} is its id number.

data.name: DurationDaysHours
data.comment: A length of time, as in "3d 4h". {0} is days, {1} hours. Keep it short.

data.name: InDuration
data.comment: A time ahead, as in "in 5h 20m". {0} is the length of time. Keep it short: it sits in a grid column.

data.name: AgoDuration
data.comment: A time past, as in "3d 4h ago". {0} is the length of time. Keep it short: it sits in a grid column.

data.name: Updated
data.comment: PI tool, beside the Refresh button. {0} is the date and time of the last reading.

data.name: SummarySeparator
data.comment: PI tool: what separates the parts of the summary line, as in "22 colonies · 3 extractors stopped". Keep the spaces as your language spaces a list.

data.name: SummaryColoniesOne
data.comment: PI tool summary line, first part. {0} is the number of colonies.

data.name: SummaryColoniesOther
data.comment: PI tool summary line, first part. {0} is the number of colonies.

data.name: SummaryStoppedOne
data.comment: PI tool summary line. {0} is the number of extractors (extractor control units) whose program has ended.

data.name: SummaryStoppedOther
data.comment: PI tool summary line. {0} is the number of extractors (extractor control units) whose program has ended.

data.name: SummaryHaulingOne
data.comment: PI tool summary line. {0} is the number of colonies whose storage is full or fills within the lead time.

data.name: SummaryHaulingOther
data.comment: PI tool summary line. {0} is the number of colonies whose storage is full or fills within the lead time.

data.name: SummaryInputsOne
data.comment: PI tool summary line. {0} is the number of factory planets whose brought-in input runs out within the lead time.

data.name: SummaryInputsOther
data.comment: PI tool summary line. {0} is the number of factory planets whose brought-in input runs out within the lead time.

data.name: TabColonies
data.comment: PI tool, tab: every colony of the characters that do Planetary Industry.

data.name: TabColony
data.comment: PI tool, tab: one colony in detail.

data.name: TabCharacters
data.comment: PI tool, tab: the characters that do Planetary Industry, their colony slots and command centers.

data.name: OpenColony
data.comment: PI tool, button: show the selected colony in detail.

data.name: TipOpenColony
data.value: Show the selected colony in detail: its pins, flows and money. A double-click on a row does the same.
data.comment: Tooltip on the Open colony button in the PI tool.

data.name: Refresh
data.comment: PI tool, button: read the colonies again.

data.name: TipRefresh
data.value: Read the colonies again. The list also refreshes every minute while it is open; new colony layouts are read from ESI every ten minutes.
data.comment: Tooltip on the Refresh button in the PI tool. ESI is the name of EVE's web API.

data.name: EstimatesNote
data.value: Extractor times are exact. Storage and input times are estimates, replayed from the last time each colony was opened in the game; the data age column says how old that is.
data.comment: Note under the summary line in the PI tool.

data.name: EmptyNote
data.value: No colonies to show yet. Colonies are read for characters with the PI box ticked on Settings → Characters; a colony appears here once its layout has been read from ESI, which happens when it was last opened in the game.
data.comment: PI tool, shown instead of an empty list. ESI is EVE's web API.

data.name: ColCharacter
data.comment: PI tool, column header: the character who owns the colony.

data.name: ColPlanet
data.comment: PI tool, column header.

data.name: ColSystem
data.comment: PI tool, column header: the solar system, after its security level.

data.name: ColType
data.comment: PI tool, column header: the planet type (Barren, Gas, …). Short.

data.name: ColKind
data.comment: PI tool, column header: Extractor or Factory planet. Short.

data.name: ColCc
data.comment: PI tool, column header: the command center's upgrade level against the highest the skill allows. Very short (about 3 characters).

data.name: ColExtractorsEnd
data.comment: PI tool, column header: when the colony's first extractor program ends (exact).

data.name: ColStorageFull
data.comment: PI tool, column header: when storage first fills (estimated).

data.name: ColInputsRunOut
data.comment: PI tool, column header: when a factory planet's brought-in input runs out (estimated).

data.name: ColStatus
data.comment: PI tool, column header: OK, Attention or Action.

data.name: ColDataAge
data.comment: PI tool, column header: how long ago the colony was last opened in the game.

data.name: ColProfit
data.comment: PI tool, column header: the colony's profit per day.

data.name: LevelOfMax
data.comment: PI tool, CC column: command center level {0} of the highest {1} the character's Command Center Upgrades skill allows.

data.name: TipCcHeadroom
data.value: Command center level {0}; Command Center Upgrades allows {1}, so it can be upgraded.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool. {0} is the command center's level, {1} the highest the skill allows. "Command Center Upgrades" is a skill name: use the game's.

data.name: TipCcAtMax
data.value: Command center level {0}: as high as Command Center Upgrades allows.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool. {0} is the level. "Command Center Upgrades" is a skill name: use the game's.

data.name: Stopped
data.comment: PI tool, Extractors end column: the extractor program has ended. Short.

data.name: TipExtractorsStopped
data.value: The first extractor stopped {0} ago, at {1}. Exact: an extractor program's end is fixed when it is set.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool. {0} is a length of time, {1} a date and time.

data.name: TipExtractorsStop
data.value: The first extractor stops at {0}. Exact: an extractor program's end is fixed when it is set.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool. {0} is a date and time.

data.name: TipNoExtractors
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool, Extractors end column of a factory planet.

data.name: Full
data.comment: PI tool: storage is full (estimated). Short.

data.name: TipStorageFull
data.value: Estimated full since {0}: output that arrives now is lost. Estimated from the last time the colony was opened in the game.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool. {0} is a date and time.

data.name: TipStorageFills
data.value: Estimated to fill at {0}, from the last time the colony was opened in the game.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool. {0} is a date and time.

data.name: NotWithinHorizon
data.comment: PI tool: the estimate does not reach this within the 30 days it looks ahead.

data.name: TipStorageNotFull
data.value: Storage does not fill within the 30 days the estimate looks ahead.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool, Storage full column.

data.name: RanOut
data.comment: PI tool, Inputs run out column: a factory planet's input has run out (estimated). Short.

data.name: TipInputsOut
data.value: Estimated to have run out at {0}: its factories are idle. Estimated from the last time the colony was opened in the game.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool. {0} is a date and time.

data.name: TipInputsRunOut
data.value: Estimated to run out at {0}, from the last time the colony was opened in the game.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool. {0} is a date and time.

data.name: TipInputsNotOut
data.value: The input brought in lasts longer than the 30 days the estimate looks ahead.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool, Inputs run out column.

data.name: TipNoInputs
data.value: Nothing is brought in: an extractor planet makes its own.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool, Inputs run out column of an extractor planet.

data.name: StateAction
data.comment: PI tool, status chip: something has already happened (extractors stopped, storage full, input gone). Short.

data.name: StateAttention
data.comment: PI tool, status chip: something comes due soon, or the data is old. Short.

data.name: StateOk
data.comment: PI tool, status chip: nothing due. Short.

data.name: AgeStale
data.comment: PI tool, Data age column, when the data is older than the setting. {0} is the age, as in "3d 4h".

data.name: TipAge
data.value: Last opened in the game at {0}.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool, Data age column. {0} is a date and time.

data.name: TipAgeStale
data.value: Last opened in the game at {0}: too long ago for its estimates to be trusted. Open the colony in the game to refresh it.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool, Data age column. {0} is a date and time.

data.name: PerDay
data.comment: PI tool: an ISK amount per day. {0} is the amount.

data.name: TipProfit
data.value: Output {0}, less inputs {1} and import and export charges {2}, a day, at market prices.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool, Profit column. {0}, {1} and {2} are ISK amounts.

data.name: KindExtractor
data.comment: PI tool, Kind column: a colony with extractors, which only sends output off. Short.

data.name: KindFactory
data.comment: PI tool, Kind column: a colony with factories only, which needs input brought in. Short.

data.name: KindEmpty
data.comment: PI tool, Kind column: a colony with neither extractors nor factories. Short.

data.name: ReasonExtractorsStopped
data.comment: Tooltip line on the PI tool's status chip.

data.name: ReasonExtractorsStopping
data.value: Extractors stop within the lead time.
data.comment: Tooltip line on the PI tool's status chip. The lead time is a setting.

data.name: ReasonStorageFull
data.comment: Tooltip line on the PI tool's status chip.

data.name: ReasonStorageFilling
data.value: Storage fills within the lead time (estimated).
data.comment: Tooltip line on the PI tool's status chip.

data.name: ReasonInputsOut
data.comment: Tooltip line on the PI tool's status chip.

data.name: ReasonInputsLow
data.value: Input runs out within the lead time (estimated).
data.comment: Tooltip line on the PI tool's status chip.

data.name: ReasonStale
data.comment: Tooltip line on the PI tool's status chip.

data.name: ReasonNothingDue
data.value: Nothing due within the lead times.
data.comment: Tooltip on the PI tool's status chip when it says OK.

data.name: CharactersNote
data.value: Characters with the PI box ticked on Settings → Characters. Colony slots come from Interplanetary Consolidation; command center levels from Command Center Upgrades.
data.comment: Note on the PI tool's Characters tab. Skill names: use the game's.

data.name: OpenPiSwitch
data.comment: PI tool, button: opens Settings → Characters, where the PI box is.

data.name: TipOpenPiSwitch
data.value: Open Settings → Characters, where each character's PI box decides whether it is in this tool, its alerts and its worklist tasks.
data.comment: Tooltip on the PI box button in the PI tool.

data.name: ColColonies
data.comment: PI tool, Characters tab, column header: colonies in use against colonies allowed.

data.name: ColFreeSlots
data.comment: PI tool, Characters tab, column header: colonies the character could still set up.

data.name: ColSkills
data.comment: PI tool, Characters tab, column header: the two PI skills' levels.

data.name: ColCommandCenters
data.comment: PI tool, Characters tab, column header: each colony's command center level against the highest allowed.

data.name: ColoniesOfAllowed
data.comment: PI tool, Characters tab: {0} colonies in use of {1} allowed.

data.name: FreeSlotsOne
data.comment: PI tool, Characters tab: {0} colony slot not used.

data.name: FreeSlotsOther
data.comment: PI tool, Characters tab: {0} colony slots not used.

data.name: NoFreeSlots
data.comment: PI tool, Characters tab: every colony slot is in use.

data.name: SkillsShort
data.comment: PI tool, Characters tab: {0} is the Interplanetary Consolidation level, {1} the Command Center Upgrades level. IC and CCU are the common abbreviations; use your language's if the players use one.

data.name: TipSkills
data.value: Interplanetary Consolidation (IC): one colony plus one per level. Command Center Upgrades (CCU): the highest command center level.
data.comment: Tooltip in the PI tool, Skills column. Skill names: use the game's.

data.name: SlotWithHeadroom
data.comment: PI tool, Characters tab: a colony whose command center can be upgraded. {0} is the planet, {1} its level, {2} the highest allowed. The arrow marks room to upgrade.

data.name: SlotAtMax
data.comment: PI tool, Characters tab: a colony at the highest command center level allowed. {0} is the planet, {1} its level, {2} the highest allowed.

data.name: NoColonySelected
data.value: Pick a colony on the Colonies tab — double-click it, or select it and press Open colony.
data.comment: PI tool, Colony tab, when no colony is chosen.

data.name: DetailSubtitle
data.comment: PI tool, Colony tab, under the planet name. {0} character, {1} system, {2} its security level, {3} planet type, {4} Extractor or Factory.

data.name: DetailAge
data.value: Data {0} old: last opened in the game at {1}. Storage, factory and input figures are estimated from then.
data.comment: PI tool, Colony tab. {0} is a length of time, {1} a date and time.

data.name: DetailAgeStale
data.value: Data {0} old: last opened in the game at {1}, too long ago for the estimates to be trusted. Open the colony in the game to refresh it.
data.comment: PI tool, Colony tab, when the data is older than the setting. {0} is a length of time, {1} a date and time.
